source: Existing local official checkout; copied without changing baseline model files

compatibility_notes.layers/AutoCorrelation.py: Replace two hard-coded CUDA index allocations with input-device allocations; original attention math unchanged

adaptations: Reuse existing FullAttention and AttentionLayer without unused tau/delta arguments
Isolate official inverted embedding so existing model embeddings are unchanged
Default missing task_name to long_term_forecast; validate forecasting configs and input dimensions
Replace in-place normalization division with equivalent out-of-place division to support input gradients
Support optional decoder arguments and output_attention=(prediction, None) runner contract; official attention-map collection remains disabled
Register traffic/Traffic as Dataset_Custom; preserve 70/10/20 split and train-only scaler
CLI traffic defaults for path and channels; TimeXer experiment IDs include patch length, normalization and seed

Optional MS target_indices: multiple independent endogenous streams share a common exogenous context excluding all selected targets; default last-channel MS remains unchanged; indices are nonpersistent buffers, selection is saved in experiment config

tslib_base.integration: Existing PatchTST project overlaid on TSLib main; current run_longExp.py entry point preserved. Shared modules retain project versions; full compatibility with the upstream run.py task runner is not yet established.
